americancurl: An American curl cat seen from a THREE-QUARTER FRONT VIEW, facing toward the viewer and slightly turned - its face and chest are visible and it is NOT seen from behind. A medium silky-coated cat whose one distinguishing feature is its EARS: each ear stands upright and firm at the base, then THE OUTER TIP OF THE EAR CURLS BACKWARD AND INWARD INTO A TIGHT VISIBLE ROLL, like a ribbon curled with scissors or a partly unrolled party horn - a distinct C-shaped curl at the tip, not merely an ear folded flat backward. The curl must be obvious and tight, showing the back of the ear tip and a small gap of open air inside the curl. It has EXACTLY ONE TAIL, a single plumed tail and no more. Sitting upright. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
angorarabbit: An Angora rabbit, clearly recognisable as a RABBIT FIRST: a rabbit's compact body, a rounded head, and two long upright ears are all clearly readable in silhouette. Its coat is LONG AND SILKY, considerably fluffier and fuller than an ordinary rabbit's, especially around the face, chest and haunches, but the fluff drapes OVER a recognisable rabbit body rather than replacing its shape - the outline still reads as a sitting rabbit, not a shapeless puff of wool. SOLID UNBROKEN OPAQUE WHITE FUR throughout, no gaps or holes anywhere in the coat. Dark eyes, small nose, whiskers. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
amikuk: An amikuk, a huge alien sea monster that is NOT humanoid and has NO human features at all. Its body is a SMOOTH BULBOUS HOODED DOME of pale grey-green hide, ridged and hunched over with no neck, like an enormous eyeless head bowed forward. THE HEAD IS COMPLETELY SMOOTH AND FEATURELESS - NO MOUTH, NO EYES, NO NOSE, NO TEETH, nothing but blank unbroken hide from crown to base, like a rounded stone or a hood with nothing inside it. IT HAS EXACTLY FOUR LIMBS IN TOTAL AND NO MORE - four immensely long thin tapering limbs hang from beneath the body, smooth and boneless like drooping tentacles, each ending in a single large hooked claw. Count the limbs: four, not five, not six. No shoulders, no chest, no face, no additional smaller limbs or tendrils. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
asanbosam: An asanbosam, a gaunt long-limbed humanoid, narrow shouldered, wiry and skeletal with ashen grey skin stretched tight over bones, NOT a heavy gorilla and NOT muscular. IT HANGS FROM A BARE TREE BRANCH SUSPENDED BY ITS FEET, exactly the way a bat hangs: its two legs reach up and its CURVED IRON FOOT-HOOKS ARE CAUGHT DIRECTLY OVER THE BRANCH, taking its whole weight - there are no feet or toes, the shins simply end in hooks of dark forged metal gripping the wood. ITS ARMS AND HANDS HANG LOOSELY DOWNWARD ALONGSIDE ITS HEAD AND BODY, doing nothing, not gripping the branch, not gripping anything - simply dangling with gravity the way the head does. A wide mouth of iron teeth, red eyes. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
ayeaye: An aye-aye clinging to a branch, a strange lemur with shaggy coarse dark brown-black fur flecked with pale guard hairs, HUGE ROUND ORANGE-YELLOW STARING EYES, and LARGE ROUNDED FURRY DARK EARS held out from the head. A pale grizzled face, prominent rodent-like front incisors. IT HAS EXACTLY TWO ARMS, AND THOSE ARMS ARE ORDINARY, NATURAL LEMUR LENGTH - short and proportional, not stretched or elongated in any way. THE EXAGGERATION IS IN ONE FINGER ONLY: on each hand, ONE EXTREMELY LONG, THIN, SKELETAL MIDDLE FINGER reaches out much longer than the hand or arm itself, while every other finger and the arm it is attached to stay completely normal in length. The arm is short; only the finger is long. An enormously long thick bushy tail, longer than its body, and two ordinary hind legs gripping the branch. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
oryx: A scientific field-guide illustration of an Arabian oryx standing on all four legs in STRICT SIDE PROFILE. A compact white antelope with a pure chalk-white body and long straight ringed horns rising from the top of its head. ITS MARKINGS ARE ALMOST BLACK: a deep blackish-brown mask covers the front of the face from between the horns down the length of the nose, a second dark band runs from the eye down the cheek, the throat carries a dark patch, and each leg is banded with the SAME NEAR-BLACK COLOUR from the knee and hock down to the hoof. The tail is tipped with the same dark shade. Every marking is a strong dark brown so deep it reads as black against the white coat.

anglerfish.desc: A deep-sea black seadevil anglerfish, matching the reference photo: a dark blackish-brown fish with a LARGE ANGULAR HEAD THAT IS NOT ROUNDED OR BALL-SHAPED. Its mouth has a CLEARLY DEFINED UPPER JAW AND LOWER JAW, and the LOWER JAW JUTS FORWARD BEYOND THE UPPER ONE, thrust out and prominent, giving it a heavy undershot underbite exactly like the reference. Both jaws are lined with long thin needle fangs that interlock. Small dull eye, spiny pectoral fins, and a single long thin stalk rising from the forehead with a small glowing bulb at the tip, curving slightly forward over the head. Redrawn in the game's clean cel-shaded illustration style with sharp linework, not photorealistic.
